language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I’m Chip.
Hi I’m Afia! I’m headed to the marketplace today to help the shop keepers sort their goods.
Goods are sorted by shape and pattern. See this shape? It’s called a parallelogram.
If I turn it, it looks different but it’s still the same size.
If I slide it, it looks exactly the same but it’s in a different place.
If I flip it, it still hasn’t changed size, but it looks backwards.
When you flip, slide and turn shapes you can make a pattern!
You can also use different shapes to make patterns,
like triangles, rectangles, hexagons and other polygons.
I’ll be sorting goods with different shapes for the shop keepers.
At the market, the first shop I’m helping at is the pottery shop.
Why don’t you join me to help sort the dishes?
Remember you can flip, turn, and slide a shape without changing it’s size.
